_notes: v1.2.0 (2026-07): dropped Notification + SessionStart — observability-only
noise (the agent is driven by the main session, not by these alerts).
Only actionable lifecycle signals remain: Stop ('your turn') and
SessionEnd ('session closed'). Stale settings.json entries that still
call `claude-hook notification|session-start` are silent-acked by the
CLI. Lifecycle matchers are the empty string — the documented
'applies always' form ('*' is a literal, not a wildcard). This syncs
the github spec with the CLI's bundled v1.2.0 (cli/src/hooks.rs).
PreToolUse: fires BEFORE Claude Code invokes a tool. Returning
permissionDecision=allow/deny/ask is the only way to gate a tool.
Claude Code only blocks on the hook when permission_mode is the
default 'plan'/'default' mode; if the user has flipped to
acceptEdits / bypassPermissions / skip, the tool runs regardless,
so winmux's `pre-tool-use` short-circuits with allow in those modes
(otherwise the user would see a dead card they can't act on).
Stop: fires when the assistant finishes a turn. winmux uses it to
trigger the optional Claude auto-summary (Phase 17) and to update
the server-side session-meta map (Phase 81: tmux session ->
claude_session_id + title in ~/.winmux/session-meta.json).
SessionEnd: teardown; Phase 81 prunes dead sessions from the map.
The PreToolUse matcher is intentionally narrow — restricting which
tools surface a winmux card. Override with `--matcher-mode all` (or
Settings → Hooks → 'Match all tools') to route EVERY tool through
winmux. Use `custom` if you've hand-edited ~/.claude/settings.json
and don't want setup-hooks to overwrite the matchers.
